name: adopcion-mascotas-api
description: REST API for pet adoption community platform

scripts.db:init: node -e "const { Pool } = require('pg'); const fs = require('fs'); require('dotenv').config(); const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); const sql = fs.readFileSync('./database/schema.sql', 'utf8'); pool.query(sql).then(() => { console.log('Database initialized successfully'); pool.end(); }).catch(err => { console.error('Database init failed:', err.message); pool.end(); process.exit(1); });"
